1.1: Shevuot shetayim shehen arba, yediot hattuma shetayim shehen arba, yetziot hashshabbat shetayim shehen arba, marot negaim shenayim shehem arbaa:
1.2: Kol sheyyesh bah yedia vattechilla vidia vassof vehelem bentayim, hare ze beole veyored. yesh bah yedia vattechilla veen bah yedia vassof, sair shennaase vifnim veyom hakkippurim tole, ad sheyyivvada lo veyavi veole veyored:
1.3: En bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof, sair hannaase vachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper, shenneemar (Bamidbar 29) millevad chattat hakkippurim, al ma shezze mechapper, ze mechapper. ma happenimi en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bo yedia, af hachitzon en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bo yedia:
1.4: Veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, seire hargalim mechapperin, aval lo seire rashe chodashim. veal ma seire rashe chodashim mechapperin, al hattahor sheachal et hattame. rabbi meir omer, kol hasseirim kapparatan shava al tumat mikdash vekadashav. haya rabbi shimon omer, seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veshel regalim mechapperin al sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, veshel yom hakkippurim mechapper al sheen bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof. amru lo, mahu sheyyikrevu ze vaze. amar lahem, yikravu. amru lo, hoil veen kapparatan shava, heach kerevin ze vaze. amar lahen, kullan bain lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav:
1.5: Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshemo, seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame. mosif alehem shel regalim, shemmechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof. mosif alehem shel yom hakkippurim, shehen mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, veal sheen bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof. amru lo, mahu sheyyikrevu ze vaze. amar lahem, hen. amru lo, im ken, yihyu shel yom hakkippurim kerevin berashe chodashim, aval heach shel rashe chodashim kerevin beyom hakkippurim lechapper kappara sheenah shellah. amar lahen, kullan bain lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav:
1.6: Veal zedon tumat mikdash vekadashav, sair hannaase vifnim veyom hakkippurim mechapperin. veal shear averot shebbattora, hakkallot vehachamurot, hazzedonot vehashshegagot, hoda velo hoda, ase velo taase, keretot umitot bet din, sair hammishtalleach mechapper:
1.7: Echad yisreelim, veechad kohanim, veechad kohen mashuach. ma ben yisreelim lechohanim ulechohen mashuach, ella sheddam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav. rabbi shimon omer, keshem sheddam hassair hannaase vifnim mechapper al yisrael, kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim. keshem shevvidduyo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael, kach vidduyo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim:

2.1: Yediot hattuma shetayim shehen arba. nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu hattuma vezachur et hakkodesh, nelam mimmennu hakkodesh vezachur et hattuma, neelmu mimmennu ze vaze veachal et hakkodesh velo yada, umishsheachal yada, hare ze veole veyored. nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu tuma vezachur et hammikdash, nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur et hattuma, neelmu mimmennu ze vaze venichnas lammikdash velo yada, umishsheyyatza yada, hare ze veole veyored:
2.2: Echad hannichnas laazara veechad hannichnas letosefet haazara, sheen mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella vemelech venavi veurim vetummim uvesanhedrin shel shivim veechad uvishte todot uveshir. uvet din mehallechin ushete todot acharehem, vechol yisrael acharehem. happenimit neechelet vehachitzona nisrafet. vechol shello naasa vechol ellu, hannichnas lesham en chayyavin aleha:
2.3: Nitma vaazara veneelma mimmennu tuma vezachur et hammikdash, nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur lattuma, nelam mimmennu ze vaze, vehishtachava o sheshshaha vichde hishtachavaa, ba lo vaarukka, chayyav. bakketzara, patur. zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash, sheen chayyavin aleha:
2.4: Veezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda shechayyavin aleha, haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti, uferash miyyad, chayyav, mippene sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato:
2.5: Rabbi eliezer omer, hashsheretz vegomer venelam mimmennu (Vayikra 5), al helem sheretz chayyav, veeno chayyav al helem mikdash. rabbi akiva omer, venelam mimmennu vehu tame (sham), al helem tuma chayyav, veeno chayyav al helem mikdash. rabbi yishmael omer, venelam venelam shete feamim, lechayyev al helem tuma veal helem mikdash:

3.1: Shevuot shetayim shehen arba, shevua sheochal veshello ochal, sheachalti veshello achalti. shevua shello ochal veachal kol shehu, chayyav, divre rabbi akiva. amru lo lerabbi akiva, hechan matzinu beochel kol shehu shehu chayyav, shezze chayyav. amar lahen rabbi akiva, vechi hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi karban, shezze medabber umevi karban. shevua shello ochal veachal veshata, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata, chayyav shetayim:
3.2: Shevua shello ochal, veachal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin, veachal, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
3.3: Shevua shello eshte veshata mashkin harebe, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello eshte yayin vashemen udevash veshata, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
3.4: Shevua shello ochal, veachal ochalim sheenan reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya, patur. shevua shello ochal, veachal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim, chayyav. rabbi shimon poter. amar, konam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom, vehu achal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim, hare ishto asura:
3.5: Echad devarim shel atzmo, veechad devarim shel acherim, veechad devarim sheyyesh bahen mammash, veechad devarim sheen bahem mammash. ketzad. amar, shevua sheetten leish peloni veshello etten, shennatatti veshello natatti, sheishan veshello ishan, sheyyashanti veshello yashanti, sheezrok tzeror layyam veshello ezrok, shezzarakti veshello zarakti. rabbi yishmael omer, eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo, shenneemar (Vayikra 5) lehara o lehetiv. amar lo rabbi akiva, im ken en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava, devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin. amar lo, meribbuy hakkatuv. amar lo, im ribba hakkatuv lechach, ribba hakkatuv lechach:
3.6: Nishba levattel et hammitzva velo vittel, patur. lekayyem velo kiyyem, patur. shehaya vaddin, sheyyehe chayyav, kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera. amar rabbi yehuda ben betera, ma im harshut sheeno mushba aleha mehar sinay, hare hu chayyav aleha, mitzva shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay, eno din sheyyehe chayyav aleha. amru lo, lo, im amarta vishvuat harshut, shekken asa vah lav kehen, tomar bishvuat mitzva shello asa vah lav kehen, sheim nishba levattel velo vittel, patur:
3.7: Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo, shevua shello ochalenna, shevua shello ochalenna, vaachalah, eno chayyav ella achat. zo hi shevuat bittuy, shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah karban ole veyored. shevuat shav, chayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur:
3.8: Ezo hi shevuat shav, nishba leshannot et hayyadua laadam, amar al haammud shel even shehu shel zahav, veal haish shehu ishsha, veal haishsha shehi ish. nishba al davar shei efshar, im lo raiti gamal shepporeach baavir, veim lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad. amar leedim bou vahaiduni, shevua shello neidecha. nishba levattel et hammitzva, shello laasot sukka, veshello littol lulav, veshello lehaniach tefillin, zo hi shevuat shav, shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur:
3.9: Shevua sheochal kikkar zo, shevua shello ochalenna, harishona shevuat bittuy vehashsheniyya shevuat shav. achalah, avar al shevuat shav. lo achalah, avar al shevuat bittuy:
3.10: Shevuat bittuy noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulin, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo. vechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah karban ole veyored:
3.11: Shevuat shav noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulim, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, umippi atzmo. vechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur. achat zo, veachat zo, hammushba mippi acherim, chayyav. ketzad. amar, lo achalti hayyom velo henachti tefillin hayyom, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav:

4.1: Shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo venashim, birchokin velo vikrovin, bichsherim velo vifsulin. veenah noheget ella varuyin lehaid, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo, umippi acherim, en chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bevet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben mippi atzmo uven mippi acherim, enan chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bevet din:
4.2: Vechayyavin al zedon hashshevua, veal shiggatah im zedon haedut, veenan chayyavin al shiggatah. uma hen chayyavin al zedon hashshevua, karban ole veyored:
4.3: Shevuat haedut ketzad. amar lishnayim bou vahaiduni. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, o sheamru lo en anu yodin lecha edut, mashbia ani alechem veamru amen, hare ellu chayyavin. hishbia alehen chamishsha feamim chutz levet din uvau levet din vehodu, peturim. kafru, chayyavim al kol achat veechat. hishbia alehen chamishsha feamim bifne vet din vechafru, enan chayyavin ella achat. amar rabbi shimon, ma taam, hoil veenam yecholin lachazor ulehodot:
4.4: Kafru shenehen keachat, shenehen chayyavin. baze achar ze, harishon chayyav vehashsheni fatur. kafar echad vehoda echad, hakkofer chayyav. hayu shete chitte edim, kafra harishona veachar kach kafra hashsheniyya, shetehem chayyavot, mippene shehaedut yechola lehitkayyem bishtehen:
4.5: Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, en chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin sheyyesh lecha veyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda, chayyavin al kol achat veechat. mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni pikdon chittin useorin vechussemin. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, en chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut sheyyesh lecha veyad peloni chittin useorin vechussemin, chayyavin al kol achat veechat:
4.6: Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni nezek vachatzi nezek, tashlume chefel, tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vesheanas ish peloni et bitti, ufitta et bitti, veshehikkani veni, veshechaval bi chaveri, veshehidlik et gedishi veyom hakkippurim, hare ellu chayyavin:
4.7: Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheani chohen, sheani levi, sheeni ven gerusha, sheeni ven chalutza, sheish peloni chohen, sheish peloni levi, sheeno ven gerusha, sheeno ven chalutza, sheanas ish peloni et bitto, ufitta et bitto, veshechaval bi veni, veshechaval bi chaveri, veshehidlik gedishi veshabbat, hare ellu feturin:
4.8: Mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheamar ish peloni litten li matayim zuz velo natan li, hare ellu feturim, sheen chayyavin ella al teviat mamon kefikkadon:
4.9: Mashbia ani alechem, keshettedun li edut shettavou uteiduni, hare ellu feturim, mippene shekkadma shevua laedut:
4.10: Amad bevet hakkeneset veamar, mashbia ani alechem sheim attem yodim li edut shettavou uteiduni, hare ellu feturin, ad sheyyihye mitkavven lahem:
4.11: Amar lishnayim, mashbia ani alechem ish peloni ufeloni, sheim attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni, shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, vehem yodin lo edut ed mippi ed o shehaya echad mehen karov o fasul, hare ellu feturin:
4.12: Shillach beyad avdo, o sheamar lahen hannitba mashbia ani alechem sheim attem yodin lo edut shettavou uteiduhu, hare ellu feturin ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea:
4.13: Mashbia ani alechem, metzavve ani alechem, oserchem ani, hare ellu chayyavin. bashshamayim uvaaretz, hare ellu feturin. beAlef dalet, beYod hei, beshadday, bitzvaot, bechannun verachum, beerech appayim verav chesed, uvechol hakkinnuyin, hare ellu chayyavin. hamekallel bechullan, chayyav, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin. hamekallel aviv veimmo bechullan, chayyav, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin. hamekallel atzmo vachavero bechullan, over belo taase. yakkecha elohim, vechen yakkecha elohim, zo hi ala hakketuva vattora. al yakkecha, vivarechcha, veyetiv lecha, rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin:

5.1: Shevuat happikkadon noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulim, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo. umippi acherim, eno chayyav ad sheyyichpor bo bevet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim, kevan shekkafar bo, chayyav. vechayyav al zedon hashshevua veal shiggatah im zedon happikkadon, veeno chayyav al shiggatah. uma chayyav al zedonah, asham bechesef shekalim:
5.2: Shevuat happikkadon ketzad. amar lo, ten li fikdoni sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, o sheamar lo en lecha veyadi, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, hare ze chayyav. hishbia alav chamishsha feamim, ben bifne vet din uven shello bifne vet din, vechafar, chayyav al kol achat veechat. amar rabbi shimon, ma taam, mippene sheyyachol lachazor ulehodot:
5.3: Hayu chamishsha tovin oto, amru lo ten lanu fikkadon sheyyesh lanu veyadecha, shevua sheen lachem beyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi velo lecha velo lecha, chayyav al kol achat veechat. rabbi eliezer omer, ad sheyyomar shevua vaacharona. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad. ten li fikkadon utesumet yad gazel vaaveda sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi fikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda, chayyav al kol achat veechat. ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi chittin useorin vechussemim, chayyav al kol achat veechat. rabbi meir omer, afillu amar chitta useora vechussemet, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
5.4: Anasta ufittita et bitti, vehu omer lo anasti velo fittiti. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. rabbi shimon poter, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. amru lo, af al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo, meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo:
5.5: Ganavta et shori, vehu omer lo ganavti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. hemit shorcha et shori, vehu omer lo hemit, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. hemit shorcha et avdi, vehu omer lo hemit, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. amar lo, chavalta vi veasita bi chabbura, vehu omer lo chavalti velo asiti vecha chabbura, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. amar lo avdo, hippalta et shinni vesimmita et eni, vehu omer lo hippalti velo simmiti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem al pi atzmo, chayyav. vesheeno meshallem al pi atzmo, patur:

6.1: Shevuat haddayyanin, hattaana shete chesef, vehahodaa beshave feruta. veim en hahodaa mimmin hattaana, patur. ketzad, shete chesef li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella feruta, patur. shete chesef uferuta li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella feruta, chayyav. mane li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi, patur. mane li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella chamishshim dinar, chayyav. mane leabba veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella chamishshim dinar, patur, mippene shehu chemeshiv aveda:
6.2: Mane li veyadecha, amar lo bifne edim hen. lemachar amar lo tenehu li. netattiv lach, patur. en lecha veyadi, chayyav. mane li veyadecha, amar lo hen, al tittenehu li ella veedim. lemachar amar lo tenehu li, netattiv lach, chayyav, mippene shetztzarich litteno lo veedim:
6.3: Litra zahav yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella litra chesef, patur. dinar zahav yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella dinar kesef, uterisit ufundeyon uferuta, chayyav, shehakkol min matbea achat. kor tevua yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella letech kitnit, patur. kor perot yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella letech kitnit, chayyav, shehakkitnit bichlal perot. teano chittin, vehoda lo visorim, patur. verabban gamliel mechayyev. hattoen lachavero vechadde shemen vehoda lo vakkankannim, admon omer, hoil vehoda lo miktzat mimmin hattaana, yishshavea. vachachamim omrim, en hahodaa mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon. teano chelim vekarkaot, vehoda vakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, bakkarkaot vechafar bakkelim, patur. hoda vemiktzat hakkarkaot, patur. bemiktzat hakkelim, chayyav, shehannechasim sheen lahem acharayut zokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut lishshava alehen:
6.4: En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan, veen mashbiin et hakkatan, aval nishbaim lakkatan velahekdesh:
6.5: Veellu devarim sheen nishbain alehen, haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot. en bahen tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. shomer chinnam eno nishba. nose sachar eno meshallem. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shechayyav beacharayutan, nishbain alehen. vesheeno chayyav beacharayutan, en nishbain alehem:
6.6: Rabbi meir omer, yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad, eser gefanim teunot masarti lach, vehalla omer enan ella chamesh, rabbi meir mechayyev shevua. vachachamim omrim, kol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu chakkarka. en nishbain ella al davar shebbammidda veshebbammishkal veshebbamminyan. ketzad, bayit male masarti lach vechis male masarti lach, vehalla omer eni yodea ella ma shehinnachta atta notel, patur. ze omer ad hazziz veze omer ad hachallon, chayyav:
6.7: Hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon, amar lo sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav vesela haya shave, patur. sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav ushelosha dinarim haya shave, chayyav. sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vesela haya shave, patur. sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vachamishsha dinarim haya shave, chayyav. umi nishba, mi shehappikkadon etzlo, shemma yishshava ze veyotzi halla et happikkadon:

7.1: Kol hannishbain shebbattora, nishbain velo meshallemin. veellu nishbain venotlin, hassachir, vehannigzal, vehannechbal, veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, vehachenvani al pinkaso. hassachir ketzad, amar lo ten li sechari sheyyesh li veyadecha, hu omer natatti, vehalla omer lo natalti, hu nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li veyadecha, vehu omer hitkabbalta dinar zahav:
7.2: Hannigzal ketzad, hayu meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno shello virshut, hu omer kelay natalta, vehu omer lo natalti, hare ze nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo shene chelim natalta, vehu omer lo natalti ella echad:
7.3: Hannechbal ketzad, hayu meidim oto shennichnas tachat yado shalem veyatza chavul, veamar lo chavalta bi, vehu omer lo chavalti, hare ze nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo chavalta bi shetayim, vehalla omer lo chavalti vecha ella echat:
7.4: Veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua ketzad, achat shevuat haedut veachat shevuat happikkadon, vaafillu shevuat shav. haya echad mehen mesachek bekuvya, umalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, shekkenegdo nishba venotel. hayu shenehen chashudin, chazra hashshevua limkomah, divre rabbi yose. rabbi meir omer, yachaloku:
7.5: Vehachenvani al pinkaso ketzad, lo sheyyomar lo katuv al pinkasi sheatta chayyav li matayim zuz, ella amar lo ten livni satayim chittin, ten lefoali besela maot, hu omer natatti vehen omrim lo natalnu, (shenehen nishbaim), hu nishba venotel vehen nishbain venotlin. amar ben nannas, ketzad ellu vain lide shevuat shav veellu vain lide shevuat shav, ella hu notel shello vishvua vehen notlin shello vishvua:
7.6: Amar lachenvani ten li vedinar perot venatan lo, amar lo ten li haddinar, amar lo netattiv lecha unetatto vaonpali, yishshava baal habbayit. natan lo et haddinar, amar lo ten li et happerot, amar lo netattim lecha veholachtan letoch betecha, yishshava chenvani. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehapperot beyado, yado al haelyona. amar lashshulchani ten li vedinar maot venatan lo, amar lo ten li et haddinar, amar lo netattiv lecha unetatto vaonpali, yishshava baal habbayit. natan lo et haddinar, amar lo ten li et hammaot, amar lo netattim lecha vehishlachtam letoch kisecha, yishshava shulchani. rabbi yehuda omer, en derech shulchani litten issar ad sheyyittol dinaro:
7.7: Keshem sheamru, happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella vishvua, veed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnechasim meshubadim uminnichse yetomim, lo tippara ella vishvua. vehannifraat shello befanav, lo tippara ella vishvua. vechen hayetomim lo yipparu ella vishvua, shevua shello fekadanu abba, velo amar lanu abba, veshello matzinu ven shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze farua. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, afillu nolad habben leachar mitat haav, hare ze nishba venotel. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, im yesh edim sheamar haav bishat mitato shetar ze eno farua, hu notel shello vishvua:
7.8: Veellu nishbaim shello vetaana, hashshuttafin, vehaarisin, vehaappotroppin, vehaishsha hannoset vehannotenet betoch habbayit, uven habbayit. amar lo ma atta toaneni, retzoni shettishshava li, chayyav. chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin, en yachol lehashebio. nitgalgela lo shevua mimmakom acher, megalgelin alav et hakkol. vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua:

8.1: Arbaa shomrin hen, shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher. shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol. vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol. nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemim et haaveda veet haggeneva:
8.2: Amar leshomer chinnam, hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad. nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad. avad, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur:
8.3: Hechan shori, amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. hechan shori, amar lo avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheachalo, meshallem et hakkeren. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vechomesh veasham. hechan shori, amar lo nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vechomesh veasham:
8.4: Amar leechad bashshuk hechan shori shegganavta, vehu omer lo ganavti, vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain, amar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti, eno meshallem ella keren:
8.5: Amar lashshoel hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad. nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad. avad, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur:
8.6: Hechan shori, amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. amar lannose sachar vehassocher hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar. nignav, vehu sheavad. avad, vehu shennignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. met o nishbar o nishba, vehu shennignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. avad, o nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. ze hakkelal, kol hameshanne mechova lechova umippetor liftor umippetor lechova, patur. mechova liftor, chayyav. ze hakkelal, kol hannishba lehakel al atzmo, chayyav. lehachemir al atzmo, patur:
